hook.name: HookPadHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for all HookPad token launch pools, enforcing a 5-second anti-snipe window with a 60% buy tax routed to the protocol treasury, followed by a dynamic tiered buy/sell tax schedule cycling per global trade count. All fees are taken from the native ETH side of every swap and forwarded to a fee locker for distribution to the token creator or treasury.
